title: Agent Metrics Provider Policy Path Audit
objective: Verify provider policy file location, inheritance, and confirm no drift for llm_professionalize or ollama routing

files_inspected.role: CANONICAL — the authoritative provider policy module

files_inspected.note: Does NOT exist. Confirmed via filesystem check.

relationship_verdict.description: There is exactly one provider_policy.py in the codebase: src/plugin_examples/llm_router/provider_policy.py. The metrics module does not have its own provider_policy.py, nor does it need one.
relationship_verdict.how_metrics_uses_provider_policy: The metrics module (src/plugin_examples/metrics/) does not directly import provider_policy.py. Provider enforcement happens upstream in the LLM router layer. By the time metrics.MetricsCollector.record_call() is invoked, the router has already enforced provider policy — only approved providers (llm_professionalize, ollama) can reach the instrumented call paths.

phase2_source_audit_error.description: The Phase 2 source audit (agent-metrics-plan-execution-source-audit.json) listed 'src/plugin_examples/metrics/provider_policy.py' as a file to audit and incorrectly reported it as existing with verdict PASS. This was an error — the file does not exist.
phase2_source_audit_error.impact: Low — the plan Section 5 requirement (approved providers: llm_professionalize, ollama) is correctly satisfied by the canonical llm_router/provider_policy.py. The metrics module does not need its own copy.
phase2_source_audit_error.correction_action: This audit file documents the truth. The Phase 2 source audit contained a false positive. No source code change required.
